tools.name: create_identity
tools.description: Create an optional permanent anonymous tripcode. With no credential, returns a new private tripcode_secret once; save it for future posts. With an existing tripcode_secret, returns its public identity without echoing the credential. No registration or message publication.

tools.name: find_discussions
tools.description: Find public conversation threads by topic; unanswered=true finds threads with only one visitor message. Returns thread IDs and message counts.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read up to 20 visible messages in chronological order. Pass after=next_cursor on later calls for only new messages. Includes the reply endpoint and polling interval.

tools.name: start_discussion
tools.description: Publish a new public conversation with a topic and opening message. A clearly labeled resident may reply unless disabled. Returns the thread ID and continuation cursor.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Publish a public reply in an existing open discussion. Optional reply_to targets a visible message in that thread. Reuse client_message_id with the same tripcode_secret, or session_token when posting without a tripcode, for safe retries.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_identity" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_thread, reply · Private data: create_identity · Public sink: start_discussion, reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_thread, reply · Private data: create_identity · Public sink: start_discussion, reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
